svg.metadata:
{"diagram_source":"workflow.d2","management_instructions":"Treat each node ID as a **checkpoint, not a rigid waterfall**. Start by reading the applicable GitHub issues/PRs, the latest linked conversation context and the **current Projects coordination file**. If the human supplies a conversation URL, use it as a resume pointer in Projects when appropriate; do not invent the URL. Keep canonical specifications and acceptance cases in GitHub issues/PRs. In Projects, record only the owning workstream, conversation link, milestone, blocker and next actionable handoff. Re-read current Projects `main` and overlapping relevant PRs before routine updates, and follow its own low-risk autonomous-merge policy rather than applying that policy to unrelated repositories.

At each node: identify the current actor; check real repo/CI state; follow the labelled conditions; ask for human consent on reserved decisions; create or update regression and scenario evidence; and verify that any claimed GitHub write actually occurred. Do not invent testing or merge results. If human UI/debugger help is needed, explain the reason, steps, expected output and exact question. If a coding agent is needed, provide a prompt with branch, issue, reproduction, evidence, tests and intended PR. If work is blocked or ends, update the Projects handoff without copying the entire issue register.

| Status field | Evidence to retain |
| --- | --- |
| Workstream | Repository, current aim, supplied conversation link and Projects pointer |
| Canonical specification | Issue/PR URLs, accepted decisions, prerequisites and acceptance tests |
| PR dependency tree | Current head, parent/child/sibling dependencies, tests and mergeable leaves |
| Diagnosis and proof | Actual reproduction, regression test, `txtar` or scenario, UI/automation evidence |
| Routing | Current node ID, condition, responsible human/Chat/coding actor |
| Handoff | Next concrete action, owner, obstacle and resumption trigger |
| Ending | Verified completed milestone, parked checkpoint or human-authorised abandonment |","node_count":73,"node_description_selector":"g[data-workflow-node] > desc","schema":"agent-workflow-node-guidance/v2","source":"index.md"}

g.text: START HERE · CHOOSE ONE ENTRY POINT

g.desc:
WS01 — Open one workstream Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Open or resume one focused conversation. Keep one coherent workstream in chat, linking its canonical issues, PRs and Project coordination record.
Enter from: ST01 Initial release (start); ST02 Planned change (start); ST03 Bug or defect (start); ST04 Maintenance (start); ST05 Existing work (start); ST06 Release request (start)
Move to: WS04 Register conversation in Projects when register chat

text.tspan: OPEN OR RESUME ONE FOCUSED CONVERSATION.

g.title: Chat LLM: Keep one coherent workstream in chat, linking its canonical issues, PRs and Project coordination record.

g.desc:
WS02 — Inspect current baseline Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Inspect issues, PRs and the current code. Re-read the current GitHub baseline and the Projects coordination record before making new assumptions.
Enter from: WS04 Register conversation in Projects (load state)
Move to: WS03 Select discovery depth? when classify

text.tspan: INSPECT ISSUES, PRS AND THE CURRENT CODE.

g.title: Chat LLM: Re-read the current GitHub baseline and the Projects coordination record before making new assumptions.

g.desc:
WS03 — Select discovery depth? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Choose planning, debugging or resumption. Route the request by its actual goal; all starts go through Projects coordination; do not force major planning for routine tasks.
Enter from: WS02 Inspect current baseline (classify)
Move to: PL01 State detailed intent when complex / unclear; SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues when clear change; BG01 Capture reproduction when bug; RV01 Inspect actual PR state when resume PR; RL01 Recommend release intent when release only
g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Route the request by its actual goal; all starts go through Projects coordination; do not force major planning for routine tasks.

g.desc:
WS04 — Register conversation in Projects Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Link this chat and its current objective. When given a conversation URL, add or update a lightweight Projects coordination pointer in the owning repo/project file; do not mirror issue details.
Enter from: WS01 Open one workstream (register chat)
Move to: WS02 Inspect current baseline when load state

text.tspan: LINK THIS CHAT AND ITS CURRENT OBJECTIVE.

g.title: Chat LLM: When given a conversation URL, add or update a lightweight Projects coordination pointer in the owning repo/project file; do not mirror issue details.

g.desc:
WS05 — Park checkpoint in Projects Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Store blockers, next action and chat link. Before a pause, record only the source PR/issue links, current blocker, resume condition and conversation URL in Projects; routine low-risk Projects changes may be autonomously merged under its own policy.
Enter from: PL05 Enough specified? (defer); SP03 Issue change approved? (pending approval); TR03 Runnable PR available? (all blocked); RV02 CI evidence usable? (required CI blocked); RV08 Merge approved? (hold); RV10 More work in PR tree? (remaining blocked); RL02 Publish now? (defer release); RL09 Public audit passed? (audit blocked); RL05 History rewrite needed? (rewrite consent pending); RL08 Release verified? (publication failed)
Move to: EN02 Deferred or blocked when checkpoint parked

text.tspan: STORE BLOCKERS, NEXT ACTION AND CHAT LINK.

g.title: Chat LLM: Before a pause, record only the source PR/issue links, current blocker, resume condition and conversation URL in Projects; routine low-risk Projects changes may be autonomously merged under its own policy.

g.desc:
WS06 — Close Projects handoff Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Record cancellation without a second tracker. On human-authorised abandonment, record why the work stopped and update or remove stale Projects handoff links, preserving canonical issues/PR history.
Enter from: PL05 Enough specified? (abandon); TR03 Runnable PR available? (cancelled); RV04 What needs changing? (cancelled); RV08 Merge approved? (cancel)
Move to: EN03 Abandoned when cancel recorded

text.tspan: RECORD CANCELLATION WITHOUT A SECOND TRACKER.

g.title: Chat LLM: On human-authorised abandonment, record why the work stopped and update or remove stale Projects handoff links, preserving canonical issues/PR history.

g.desc:
BG01 — Capture reproduction Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Record steps to reproduce and expected results. Capture reproduction, observed-versus-expected behaviour, logs, versions, screenshots and context.
Enter from: WS03 Select discovery depth? (bug); BG05 Root cause supported? (insufficient evidence)
Move to: BG02 Who investigates? when reproduction recorded

text.tspan: RECORD STEPS TO REPRODUCE AND EXPECTED RESULTS.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Capture reproduction, observed-versus-expected behaviour, logs, versions, screenshots and context.

g.desc:
BG02 — Who investigates? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Route to chat, coding agent or human. Select human interactive, Chat LLM research or Coding LLM investigation
Enter from: BG01 Capture reproduction (reproduction recorded)
Move to: BG08 Request human investigation when human debug; BG04 Chat investigates when chat debug; BG06 Prepare coding-agent diagnosis when agent debug

text.tspan: ROUTE TO CHAT, CODING AGENT OR HUMAN.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Select human interactive, Chat LLM research or Coding LLM investigation

g.desc:
BG03 — Human interactive investigation Actor: Human. Shape: rectangle. State: Run the app and report findings to chat. Execute local UI or debugger steps from the Chat LLM request and return reproducible evidence.
Enter from: BG08 Request human investigation (human steps shared)
Move to: BG05 Root cause supported? when human findings

text.tspan: RUN THE APP AND REPORT FINDINGS TO CHAT.

g.title: Human: Execute local UI or debugger steps from the Chat LLM request and return reproducible evidence.

g.desc:
BG04 — Chat investigates Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Analyse evidence and try a small fix. Investigate directly where tools allow; a verified fix proceeds through issue and PR workflow, otherwise escalate with focused evidence.
Enter from: BG02 Who investigates? (chat debug)
Move to: BG05 Root cause supported? when chat findings

text.tspan: ANALYSE EVIDENCE AND TRY A SMALL FIX.

g.title: Chat LLM: Investigate directly where tools allow; a verified fix proceeds through issue and PR workflow, otherwise escalate with focused evidence.

g.desc:
BG05 — Root cause supported? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Check the diagnosis against the evidence. Evaluate whether logs, reproduction, tests and human feedback support the root cause; loop or reframe if they do not.
Enter from: BG03 Human interactive investigation (human findings); BG04 Chat investigates (chat findings); BG09 Coding agent diagnoses (agent findings)
Move to: BG01 Capture reproduction when insufficient evidence; PL01 State detailed intent when needs redesign; BG07 Specify regression proof when cause supported

text.tspan: CHECK THE DIAGNOSIS AGAINST THE EVIDENCE.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Evaluate whether logs, reproduction, tests and human feedback support the root cause; loop or reframe if they do not.

g.desc:
BG06 — Prepare coding-agent diagnosis Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Write the prompt, evidence and test request. Supply the coding-agent investigation prompt to the human with reproduction, hypotheses, testing expectations and exact PR/issue context.
Enter from: BG02 Who investigates? (agent debug)
Move to: BG09 Coding agent diagnoses when coding prompt

text.tspan: WRITE THE PROMPT, EVIDENCE AND TEST REQUEST.

g.title: Chat LLM: Supply the coding-agent investigation prompt to the human with reproduction, hypotheses, testing expectations and exact PR/issue context.

g.desc:
BG07 — Specify regression proof Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Plan a failing test and scenario evidence. Specify the test to add or update, with unit, txtar, integration or scenario proof that would demonstrate the bug and prevent a recurrence; implement it with the fix later.
Enter from: BG05 Root cause supported? (cause supported)
Move to: SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues when regression criteria

text.tspan: PLAN A FAILING TEST AND SCENARIO EVIDENCE.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Specify the test to add or update, with unit, txtar, integration or scenario proof that would demonstrate the bug and prevent a recurrence; implement it with the fix later.

g.desc:
BG08 — Request human investigation Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Explain why and provide runnable steps. Explain why a manual device/UI debugger run is needed, give steps, flowchart or rationale, and ask the human for exact observations and output.
Enter from: BG02 Who investigates? (human debug)
Move to: BG03 Human interactive investigation when human steps shared

text.tspan: EXPLAIN WHY AND PROVIDE RUNNABLE STEPS.

g.title: Chat LLM: Explain why a manual device/UI debugger run is needed, give steps, flowchart or rationale, and ask the human for exact observations and output.

g.desc:
BG09 — Coding agent diagnoses Actor: Coding LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Run investigations and return evidence. Investigate the prepared prompt in a repository/worktree, run experiments and tests, and send findings back to Chat LLM for verification; do not self-approve the diagnosis.
Enter from: BG06 Prepare coding-agent diagnosis (coding prompt)
Move to: BG05 Root cause supported? when agent findings
g.title: Coding LLM: Investigate the prepared prompt in a repository/worktree, run experiments and tests, and send findings back to Chat LLM for verification; do not self-approve the diagnosis.

g.desc:
PL01 — State detailed intent Actor: Human. Shape: rectangle. State: Explain the goal, constraints and examples. Describe what, why, constraints, examples and desired approach; answer and ask questions
Enter from: WS03 Select discovery depth? (complex / unclear); BG05 Root cause supported? (needs redesign); PL05 Enough specified? (not ready); RV04 What needs changing? (design mismatch); RL09 Public audit passed? (fundamental failure)
Move to: PL02 Ask clarifying questions when clarify

text.tspan: EXPLAIN THE GOAL, CONSTRAINTS AND EXAMPLES.

g.title: Human: Describe what, why, constraints, examples and desired approach; answer and ask questions

g.desc:
PL02 — Ask clarifying questions Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Ask what is missing or unclear. Ask targeted questions; revise scope after every material change
Enter from: PL01 State detailed intent (clarify); PL04 Resolve contradictions (decisions revised)
Move to: PL03 Contradictions found? when compare requirements

text.tspan: ASK WHAT IS MISSING OR UNCLEAR.

g.title: Chat LLM: Ask targeted questions; revise scope after every material change

g.desc:
PL03 — Contradictions found? Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Check whether requirements disagree. Search for conflicts in requirements, design, scope, tests and assumptions; route yes to resolution and no to sufficiency check.
Enter from: PL02 Ask clarifying questions (compare requirements)
Move to: PL04 Resolve contradictions when conflict found; PL05 Enough specified? when no conflict
g.title: Chat LLM: Search for conflicts in requirements, design, scope, tests and assumptions; route yes to resolution and no to sufficiency check.

g.desc:
PL04 — Resolve contradictions Actor: Human. Shape: rectangle. State: Discuss, decide or defer conflicting needs. Decide between conflicting requirements, ask follow-up questions, then recheck the revised specification.
Enter from: PL03 Contradictions found? (conflict found)
Move to: PL02 Ask clarifying questions when decisions revised

text.tspan: DISCUSS, DECIDE OR DEFER CONFLICTING NEEDS.

g.title: Human: Decide between conflicting requirements, ask follow-up questions, then recheck the revised specification.

g.desc:
PL05 — Enough specified? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Decide whether there is enough to start. Advance when sufficient, not necessarily complete; otherwise loop or park
Enter from: PL03 Contradictions found? (no conflict)
Move to: PL01 State detailed intent when not ready; WS05 Park checkpoint in Projects when defer; WS06 Close Projects handoff when abandon; SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues when sufficient

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER THERE IS ENOUGH TO START.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Advance when sufficient, not necessarily complete; otherwise loop or park

g.desc:
SP01 — Reconcile GitHub issues Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Match the work to existing GitHub issues. Search existing issues and PRs; align expected outcomes and acceptance cases
Enter from: WS03 Select discovery depth? (clear change); BG07 Specify regression proof (regression criteria); PL05 Enough specified? (sufficient); RV04 What needs changing? (issue mismatch)
Move to: SP02 Issue record adequate? when inspect issue

text.tspan: MATCH THE WORK TO EXISTING GITHUB ISSUES.

g.title: Chat LLM: Search existing issues and PRs; align expected outcomes and acceptance cases

g.desc:
SP02 — Issue record adequate? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Check whether an issue covers the work. Check missing tests, issue ownership, resolving scope and change implications
Enter from: SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues (inspect issue)
Move to: SP03 Issue change approved? when approval needed; SP04 Persist accepted spec when existing issue valid

text.tspan: CHECK WHETHER AN ISSUE COVERS THE WORK.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Check missing tests, issue ownership, resolving scope and change implications

g.desc:
SP03 — Issue change approved? Actor: Human. Shape: diamond. State: Approve a new issue or major rewrite. Decide whether an issue should be created or materially rewritten; routine authorised updates to existing issues need no fresh approval.
Enter from: SP02 Issue record adequate? (approval needed)
Move to: SP04 Persist accepted spec when approved; WS05 Park checkpoint in Projects when pending approval

text.tspan: APPROVE A NEW ISSUE OR MAJOR REWRITE.

g.title: Human: Decide whether an issue should be created or materially rewritten; routine authorised updates to existing issues need no fresh approval.

g.desc:
SP04 — Persist accepted spec Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Keep approved detail in issues and PRs. Record canonical requirements and acceptance checks in issues and PR descriptions, not duplicated into Projects.
Enter from: SP02 Issue record adequate? (existing issue valid); SP03 Issue change approved? (approved)
Move to: SP05 New repository required? when recorded

text.tspan: KEEP APPROVED DETAIL IN ISSUES AND PRS.

g.title: Chat LLM: Record canonical requirements and acceptance checks in issues and PR descriptions, not duplicated into Projects.

g.desc:
SP05 — New repository required? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Choose bootstrap or an existing repo. After recording canonical issue/spec requirements, decide if a new repository needs bootstrapping or an existing repository can proceed.
Enter from: SP04 Persist accepted spec (recorded)
Move to: TR05 Bootstrap repository when new repo; TR01 Work size and dependency? when existing repo

text.tspan: CHOOSE BOOTSTRAP OR AN EXISTING REPO.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: After recording canonical issue/spec requirements, decide if a new repository needs bootstrapping or an existing repository can proceed.

g.desc:
TR01 — Work size and dependency? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Decide whether one PR is enough. Choose scope from dependencies and likely conflicts, not arbitrary linear stacking
Enter from: SP05 New repository required? (existing repo); TR05 Bootstrap repository (bootstrapped)
Move to: TR02 Plan PR dependency tree when dependent PRs; EX01 Who implements? when single PR

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER ONE PR IS ENOUGH.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Choose scope from dependencies and likely conflicts, not arbitrary linear stacking

g.desc:
TR02 — Plan PR dependency tree Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Map PR dependencies and merge order. Map sibling PRs that can merge independently and dependent children that must wait
Enter from: TR01 Work size and dependency? (dependent PRs)
Move to: TR03 Runnable PR available? when tree ready

text.tspan: MAP PR DEPENDENCIES AND MERGE ORDER.

g.title: Chat LLM: Map sibling PRs that can merge independently and dependent children that must wait

g.desc:
TR03 — Runnable PR available? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Choose an unblocked branch or park work. Choose an independently runnable leaf; if none is available record why work is blocked; cancel only with human agreement.
Enter from: TR02 Plan PR dependency tree (tree ready); RV10 More work in PR tree? (next PR)
Move to: EX01 Who implements? when runnable; WS05 Park checkpoint in Projects when all blocked; WS06 Close Projects handoff when cancelled

text.tspan: CHOOSE AN UNBLOCKED BRANCH OR PARK WORK.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Choose an independently runnable leaf; if none is available record why work is blocked; cancel only with human agreement.

g.desc:
TR05 — Bootstrap repository Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Set up the repo, tests and documentation. After human scope approval, initialise the repository, essential CI, documentation and licence, delegating source setup to the coding model as needed
Enter from: SP05 New repository required? (new repo)
Move to: TR01 Work size and dependency? when bootstrapped

text.tspan: SET UP THE REPO, TESTS AND DOCUMENTATION.

g.title: Chat LLM: After human scope approval, initialise the repository, essential CI, documentation and licence, delegating source setup to the coding model as needed

g.desc:
TR04 — Dogfood verification needed? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Decide how to test this PR milestone. This reachable gate follows publication of each PR; decide whether to prepare an explicit dogfood/UI test before review.
Enter from: EX04 Publish PR tree (PR published); EX05 Chat direct fix (PR published)
Move to: TR06 Prepare dogfood test plan when dogfood needed; RV01 Inspect actual PR state when standard review

text.tspan: DECIDE HOW TO TEST THIS PR MILESTONE.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: This reachable gate follows publication of each PR; decide whether to prepare an explicit dogfood/UI test before review.

g.desc:
TR06 — Prepare dogfood test plan Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Ask for human or automated milestone proof. Select practical UI/dogfood steps, Playwright, screenshot, prototype, txtar or scenario evidence for the current PR milestone, and attach or request evidence for review.
Enter from: TR04 Dogfood verification needed? (dogfood needed)
Move to: RV01 Inspect actual PR state when test plan linked

text.tspan: ASK FOR HUMAN OR AUTOMATED MILESTONE PROOF.

g.title: Chat LLM: Select practical UI/dogfood steps, Playwright, screenshot, prototype, txtar or scenario evidence for the current PR milestone, and attach or request evidence for review.

g.desc:
EX01 — Who implements? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Use chat directly or prompt a coding agent. Chat should fix small scoped changes itself when it has adequate access and verification; otherwise delegate with a prompt.
Enter from: TR01 Work size and dependency? (single PR); TR03 Runnable PR available? (runnable)
Move to: EX05 Chat direct fix when chat direct; EX02 Prepare implementation when coding agent

text.tspan: USE CHAT DIRECTLY OR PROMPT A CODING AGENT.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Chat should fix small scoped changes itself when it has adequate access and verification; otherwise delegate with a prompt.

g.desc:
EX02 — Prepare implementation Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Write a runnable prompt with test criteria. Include branch, canonical issue acceptance criteria, PR dependencies, regression tests and txtar/scenario/integration tests where helpful.
Enter from: EX01 Who implements? (coding agent); RV06 Complex correction (corrective prompt)
Move to: EX03 Code and test locally when prompt accepted

text.tspan: WRITE A RUNNABLE PROMPT WITH TEST CRITERIA.

g.title: Chat LLM: Include branch, canonical issue acceptance criteria, PR dependencies, regression tests and txtar/scenario/integration tests where helpful.

g.desc:
EX03 — Code and test locally Actor: Coding LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Implement the change and prove its behaviour. Write or update unit and larger end-to-end, txtar, integration or scenario proof, then run tests and inspect output.
Enter from: EX02 Prepare implementation (prompt accepted)
Move to: EX04 Publish PR tree when tested implementation

text.tspan: IMPLEMENT THE CHANGE AND PROVE ITS BEHAVIOUR.

g.title: Coding LLM: Write or update unit and larger end-to-end, txtar, integration or scenario proof, then run tests and inspect output.

g.desc:
EX04 — Publish PR tree Actor: Coding LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Push code and open linked pull requests. Coding LLM (Codex/Agy): Push real commits and create the promised PRs, with explicit dependent bases and linked issues
Enter from: EX03 Code and test locally (tested implementation)
Move to: TR04 Dogfood verification needed? when PR published

text.tspan: PUSH CODE AND OPEN LINKED PULL REQUESTS.

g.title: Coding LLM (Codex/Agy): Push real commits and create the promised PRs, with explicit dependent bases and linked issues

g.desc:
EX05 — Chat direct fix Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Fix a small change and run its tests. Directly implement when capable, add focused regression and scenario proof, publish to PR, otherwise delegate to EX02.
Enter from: EX01 Who implements? (chat direct)
Move to: TR04 Dogfood verification needed? when PR published

text.tspan: FIX A SMALL CHANGE AND RUN ITS TESTS.

g.title: Chat LLM: Directly implement when capable, add focused regression and scenario proof, publish to PR, otherwise delegate to EX02.

g.desc:
RV01 — Inspect actual PR state Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Inspect what the PR actually contains. Verify published commits, comments, PR metadata, dependencies and fresh tests
Enter from: WS03 Select discovery depth? (resume PR); TR04 Dogfood verification needed? (standard review); TR06 Prepare dogfood test plan (test plan linked); RV05 Small repair (republished)
Move to: RV02 CI evidence usable? when current head

text.tspan: INSPECT WHAT THE PR ACTUALLY CONTAINS.

g.title: Chat LLM: Verify published commits, comments, PR metadata, dependencies and fresh tests

g.desc:
RV02 — CI evidence usable? Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Distinguish passing, missing and blocked CI. Check current head and mandatory CI evidence, distinguish missing quota from actual success; route required blocked checks to coordination hold.
Enter from: RV01 Inspect actual PR state (current head)
Move to: RV03 Review correctness? when CI usable; WS05 Park checkpoint in Projects when required CI blocked

text.tspan: DISTINGUISH PASSING, MISSING AND BLOCKED CI.

g.title: Chat LLM: Check current head and mandatory CI evidence, distinguish missing quota from actual success; route required blocked checks to coordination hold.

g.desc:
RV03 — Review correctness? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Review the requirements and regression proof. Review correctness, test quality, realistic high-level txtar/scenario coverage, issue/PR traceability and code-level tests.
Enter from: RV02 CI evidence usable? (CI usable)
Move to: RV04 What needs changing? when findings

text.tspan: REVIEW THE REQUIREMENTS AND REGRESSION PROOF.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Review correctness, test quality, realistic high-level txtar/scenario coverage, issue/PR traceability and code-level tests.

g.desc:
RV04 — What needs changing? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Choose the right correction or review path. Route repair to smallest appropriate stage, including back to Q&A and issue specifications
Enter from: RV03 Review correctness? (findings); RV14 Review evidence accepted? (incorrect or unproven); RV08 Merge approved? (changes requested)
Move to: RV05 Small repair when small fix; RV06 Complex correction when complex fix; PL01 State detailed intent when design mismatch; SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues when issue mismatch; RV07 Human PR review when reviewable; WS06 Close Projects handoff when cancelled

text.tspan: CHOOSE THE RIGHT CORRECTION OR REVIEW PATH.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Route repair to smallest appropriate stage, including back to Q&A and issue specifications

g.desc:
RV05 — Small repair Actor: Human. Shape: rectangle. State: Fix a straightforward issue or conflict. Resolve trivial conflict or tiny fix; Chat may patch when authorised, then republish and review
Enter from: RV04 What needs changing? (small fix)
Move to: RV01 Inspect actual PR state when republished

text.tspan: FIX A STRAIGHTFORWARD ISSUE OR CONFLICT.

g.title: Human: Resolve trivial conflict or tiny fix; Chat may patch when authorised, then republish and review

g.desc:
RV06 — Complex correction Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Send a focused request to a coding agent. Produce targeted prompt for Codex/Agy; repair existing branch/PR when safe
Enter from: RV04 What needs changing? (complex fix)
Move to: EX02 Prepare implementation when corrective prompt

text.tspan: SEND A FOCUSED REQUEST TO A CODING AGENT.

g.title: Chat LLM: Produce targeted prompt for Codex/Agy; repair existing branch/PR when safe

g.desc:
RV07 — Human PR review Actor: Human. Shape: rectangle. State: Review changes and verify user-facing results. Review the PR and test meaningful UI or bug behaviour; delegate screenshots, Playwright or prototypes when they can provide reliable evidence.
Enter from: RV04 What needs changing? (reviewable)
Move to: RV11 What verification is needed? when review evidence

text.tspan: REVIEW CHANGES AND VERIFY USER-FACING RESULTS.

g.title: Human: Review the PR and test meaningful UI or bug behaviour; delegate screenshots, Playwright or prototypes when they can provide reliable evidence.

g.desc:
RV08 — Merge approved? Actor: Human. Shape: diamond. State: Decide whether this PR may be merged. Explicit approval; passing CI or model readiness is not merge authority
Enter from: RV14 Review evidence accepted? (accepted)
Move to: RV04 What needs changing? when changes requested; WS05 Park checkpoint in Projects when hold; WS06 Close Projects handoff when cancel; RV09 Merge eligible node when human approved

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER THIS PR MAY BE MERGED.

g.title: Human: Explicit approval; passing CI or model readiness is not merge authority

g.desc:
RV09 — Merge eligible node Actor: GitHub / CI. Shape: rectangle. State: Merge a reviewed, eligible pull request. Merge only valid, approved PR with required checks and dependency prerequisites satisfied
Enter from: RV08 Merge approved? (human approved)
Move to: RV10 More work in PR tree? when merged

text.tspan: MERGE A REVIEWED, ELIGIBLE PULL REQUEST.

g.title: GitHub / CI: Merge only valid, approved PR with required checks and dependency prerequisites satisfied

g.desc:
RV10 — More work in PR tree? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Continue siblings or close the milestone. Update bases and conflicts; choose another ready sibling or pause dependent branch
Enter from: RV09 Merge eligible node (merged)
Move to: TR03 Runnable PR available? when next PR; CL01 Audit issues and PRs when milestone complete; WS05 Park checkpoint in Projects when remaining blocked

text.tspan: RV10 · MORE WORK IN PR TREE?
CONTINUE SIBLINGS OR CLOSE THE MILESTONE.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Update bases and conflicts; choose another ready sibling or pause dependent branch

g.desc:
RV11 — What verification is needed? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Choose manual, automated or none. After reviewing the PR, decide whether interactive UI/bug proof or automated Playwright/scenario evidence is needed; do not assume an earlier bug hypothesis was correct.
Enter from: RV07 Human PR review (review evidence)
Move to: RV12 Human verifies the result when human / device; RV13 Automate the proof when automated / preview; RV14 Review evidence accepted? when no extra test
g.title: Human or Chat LLM: After reviewing the PR, decide whether interactive UI/bug proof or automated Playwright/scenario evidence is needed; do not assume an earlier bug hypothesis was correct.

g.desc:
RV12 — Human verifies the result Actor: Human. Shape: rectangle. State: Run the change and confirm real behaviour. Run a local or installed build, reproduce the original bug, test changed UI and report whether the analysis/PR actually solved it; return discrepancies for revision.
Enter from: RV11 What verification is needed? (human / device)
Move to: RV14 Review evidence accepted? when user findings

text.tspan: RUN THE CHANGE AND CONFIRM REAL BEHAVIOUR.

g.title: Human: Run a local or installed build, reproduce the original bug, test changed UI and report whether the analysis/PR actually solved it; return discrepancies for revision.

g.desc:
RV13 — Automate the proof Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Use Playwright, scenarios or previews. Provide or delegate trusted UI automation, Playwright, screenshots, previews, integration tests or txtar/scenario evidence, attached to PR or shared for human assessment.
Enter from: RV11 What verification is needed? (automated / preview)
Move to: RV14 Review evidence accepted? when automation findings
g.title: Chat LLM: Provide or delegate trusted UI automation, Playwright, screenshots, previews, integration tests or txtar/scenario evidence, attached to PR or shared for human assessment.

g.desc:
RV14 — Review evidence accepted? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Fix objections or request merge approval. Compare manual and automated results against issue requirements and original bug hypothesis; route incorrect analysis back to diagnosis or issue correction.
Enter from: RV11 What verification is needed? (no extra test); RV12 Human verifies the result (user findings); RV13 Automate the proof (automation findings)
Move to: RV04 What needs changing? when incorrect or unproven; RV08 Merge approved? when accepted

text.tspan: FIX OBJECTIONS OR REQUEST MERGE APPROVAL.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Compare manual and automated results against issue requirements and original bug hypothesis; route incorrect analysis back to diagnosis or issue correction.

g.desc:
CL01 — Audit issues and PRs Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Check issues, tests and PR closeout evidence. Verify canonical issues, resolving keywords, regression and scenario proof, remaining blockers and correct PR merge state.
Enter from: RV10 More work in PR tree? (milestone complete)
Move to: CL02 Notify dependencies when issues checked

text.tspan: CHECK ISSUES, TESTS AND PR CLOSEOUT EVIDENCE.

g.title: Chat LLM: Verify canonical issues, resolving keywords, regression and scenario proof, remaining blockers and correct PR merge state.

g.desc:
CL02 — Notify dependencies Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Update anything that depends on this work. Check version constraints, dependent PRs, projects and actionable update notices
Enter from: CL01 Audit issues and PRs (issues checked)
Move to: CL03 Sync Projects coordination when dependency updates

text.tspan: UPDATE ANYTHING THAT DEPENDS ON THIS WORK.

g.title: Chat LLM: Check version constraints, dependent PRs, projects and actionable update notices

g.desc:
CL03 — Sync Projects coordination Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Update conversation pointer and resume state. Keep the arran4/projects handoff index current at milestone closeout; issues/PRs carry implementation detail, Projects links conversation, status, blockers and next action.
Enter from: CL02 Notify dependencies (dependency updates)
Move to: CL04 Update PR repository when checkpoint current

text.tspan: UPDATE CONVERSATION POINTER AND RESUME STATE.

g.title: Chat LLM: Keep the arran4/projects handoff index current at milestone closeout; issues/PRs carry implementation detail, Projects links conversation, status, blockers and next action.

g.desc:
CL04 — Update PR repository Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Record announcement tasks and readiness. Update arran4/public-relations with accurate materials or future campaign tasks
Enter from: CL03 Sync Projects coordination (checkpoint current)
Move to: RL01 Recommend release intent when announcement reviewed
g.title: Chat LLM: Update arran4/public-relations with accurate materials or future campaign tasks

g.desc:
RL01 — Recommend release intent Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Choose whether and how to release this work. Use accepted scope, roadmap, merged changes and release guidance; patch may be routine if authorised
Enter from: WS03 Select discovery depth? (release only); CL04 Update PR repository (announcement reviewed)
Move to: RL02 Publish now? when recommend version

text.tspan: CHOOSE WHETHER AND HOW TO RELEASE THIS WORK.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Use accepted scope, roadmap, merged changes and release guidance; patch may be routine if authorised

g.desc:
RL02 — Publish now? Actor: Human. Shape: diamond. State: Decide whether it is time to publish. May choose no release, normal versioned release, or delayed/public opening
Enter from: RL01 Recommend release intent (recommend version)
Move to: EN01 Completed when no release needed; WS05 Park checkpoint in Projects when defer release; RL03 First public opening? when release approved

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER IT IS TIME TO PUBLISH.

g.title: Human: May choose no release, normal versioned release, or delayed/public opening

g.desc:
RL03 — First public opening? Actor: Human. Shape: diamond. State: Check whether the repo must become public. If private-to-public, require broader quality, provenance, licence, copyright and link checks
Enter from: RL02 Publish now? (release approved)
Move to: RL07 Run release workflow when already public; RL04 Audit public exposure when first public opening

text.tspan: CHECK WHETHER THE REPO MUST BECOME PUBLIC.

g.title: Human: If private-to-public, require broader quality, provenance, licence, copyright and link checks

g.desc:
RL04 — Audit public exposure Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Inspect history, secrets, links and licences. Inspect repository history, links, copyright, documentation, quality and release assets
Enter from: RL03 First public opening? (first public opening)
Move to: RL09 Public audit passed? when audit findings

text.tspan: INSPECT HISTORY, SECRETS, LINKS AND LICENCES.

g.title: Chat LLM: Inspect repository history, links, copyright, documentation, quality and release assets

g.desc:
RL05 — History rewrite needed? Actor: Human. Shape: diamond. State: Ask before rewriting published Git history. Force-push or rewrite only on explicit informed approval; consider collaborators and tags
Enter from: RL09 Public audit passed? (audit clear)
Move to: RL06 Approve visibility change when no rewrite / approved; WS05 Park checkpoint in Projects when rewrite consent pending

text.tspan: ASK BEFORE REWRITING PUBLISHED GIT HISTORY.

g.title: Human: Force-push or rewrite only on explicit informed approval; consider collaborators and tags

g.desc:
RL06 — Approve visibility change Actor: Human. Shape: rectangle. State: Approve making the repository public. Make public only after verified audit and approval
Enter from: RL05 History rewrite needed? (no rewrite / approved)
Move to: RL07 Run release workflow when public approved
g.title: Human: Make public only after verified audit and approval

g.desc:
RL07 — Run release workflow Actor: GitHub / CI. Shape: rectangle. State: Run the approved tagging and release action. Use documented release-safe action to tag and publish; no duplicate release publisher
Enter from: RL03 First public opening? (already public); RL06 Approve visibility change (public approved)
Move to: RL10 Inspect published assets when workflow complete

text.tspan: RUN THE APPROVED TAGGING AND RELEASE ACTION.

g.title: GitHub / CI: Use documented release-safe action to tag and publish; no duplicate release publisher

g.desc:
RL08 — Release verified? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Confirm the actual published result. Decide whether published assets, tag, package, repository visibility and downstream checks really succeeded; otherwise record failed release.
Enter from: RL10 Inspect published assets (observed artifacts)
Move to: EN01 Completed when verified; WS05 Park checkpoint in Projects when publication failed
g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Decide whether published assets, tag, package, repository visibility and downstream checks really succeeded; otherwise record failed release.

g.desc:
RL09 — Public audit passed? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. Shape: diamond. State: Decide if publication requirements are met. Determine whether secret, history, licence, link and quality checks are adequate; unresolved fundamental issues return to design, while blocking items pause release.
Enter from: RL04 Audit public exposure (audit findings)
Move to: RL05 History rewrite needed? when audit clear; PL01 State detailed intent when fundamental failure; WS05 Park checkpoint in Projects when audit blocked

text.tspan: DECIDE IF PUBLICATION REQUIREMENTS ARE MET.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Determine whether secret, history, licence, link and quality checks are adequate; unresolved fundamental issues return to design, while blocking items pause release.

g.desc:
RL10 — Inspect published assets Actor: Chat LLM. Shape: rectangle. State: Check tag, packages and downstream state. Inspect actual GitHub tag, release, uploaded artifacts, package/overlay and visibility after the release workflow, then hand off the outcome for confirmation.
Enter from: RL07 Run release workflow (workflow complete)
Move to: RL08 Release verified? when observed artifacts

text.tspan: CHECK TAG, PACKAGES AND DOWNSTREAM STATE.

g.title: Chat LLM: Inspect actual GitHub tag, release, uploaded artifacts, package/overlay and visibility after the release workflow, then hand off the outcome for confirmation.

g.desc:
EN01 — Completed Actor: GitHub / CI. Shape: oval. State: Finish the verified milestone at the end. Work and any authorised release completed; issue and tracker state reconciled
Enter from: RL02 Publish now? (no release needed); RL08 Release verified? (verified)
Move to: Terminal state; retain the outcome and supporting issue/PR evidence.

text.tspan: FINISH THE VERIFIED MILESTONE AT THE END.

g.title: GitHub / CI: Work and any authorised release completed; issue and tracker state reconciled

g.desc:
EN02 — Deferred or blocked Actor: GitHub / CI. Shape: oval. State: Record the blocker and how to resume. Record a concrete resumption trigger, owner, conversation URL and authoritative issue/PR links in Projects when applicable.
Enter from: WS05 Park checkpoint in Projects (checkpoint parked)
Move to: Terminal state; retain the outcome and supporting issue/PR evidence.

text.tspan: RECORD THE BLOCKER AND HOW TO RESUME.

g.title: Chat LLM: Record a concrete resumption trigger, owner, conversation URL and authoritative issue/PR links in Projects when applicable.

g.desc:
EN03 — Abandoned Actor: Human. Shape: oval. State: Record why and close the handoff. Explicitly abandon the work and reconcile obsolete issues/PRs, with a concise Projects coordination update.
Enter from: WS06 Close Projects handoff (cancel recorded)
Move to: Terminal state; retain the outcome and supporting issue/PR evidence.

text.tspan: RECORD WHY AND CLOSE THE HANDOFF.

g.title: Human: Explicitly abandon the work and reconcile obsolete issues/PRs, with a concise Projects coordination update.

g.desc:
ST01 — Initial release Actor: Human. Shape: circle. State: Begin a new repository or initial release. A new project or first public version
Enter from: No incoming edge: choose this starting point from the entry frame.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when start

text.tspan: BEGIN A NEW REPOSITORY OR INITIAL RELEASE.

g.title: Human: A new project or first public version

g.desc:
ST02 — Planned change Actor: Human. Shape: circle. State: Request a feature or improvement. A feature or change of any size; classify scope later
Enter from: No incoming edge: choose this starting point from the entry frame.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when start
g.title: Human: A feature or change of any size; classify scope later

g.desc:
ST03 — Bug or defect Actor: Human. Shape: circle. State: Report unexpected behaviour to be fixed. An observed failure, including interactive Flutter problems
Enter from: No incoming edge: choose this starting point from the entry frame.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when start

text.tspan: REPORT UNEXPECTED BEHAVIOUR TO BE FIXED.

g.title: Human: An observed failure, including interactive Flutter problems

g.desc:
ST04 — Maintenance Actor: Human. Shape: circle. State: Start dependency, tooling or audit upkeep. Manual or automated upkeep; also may be folded into another workstream
Enter from: No incoming edge: choose this starting point from the entry frame.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when start

text.tspan: START DEPENDENCY, TOOLING OR AUDIT UPKEEP.

g.title: Human: Manual or automated upkeep; also may be folded into another workstream

g.desc:
ST05 — Existing work Actor: Human. Shape: circle. State: Resume an issue, PR or paused conversation. Resume an existing issue, PR tree or review checkpoint
Enter from: No incoming edge: choose this starting point from the entry frame.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when start

text.tspan: RESUME AN ISSUE, PR OR PAUSED CONVERSATION.

g.title: Human: Resume an existing issue, PR tree or review checkpoint

g.desc:
ST06 — Release request Actor: Human. Shape: circle. State: Consider releasing already merged work. Release-only entry that does not require new code
Enter from: No incoming edge: choose this starting point from the entry frame.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when start
g.title: Human: Release-only entry that does not require new code
Chat LLM: Keep one coherent workstream in chat, linking its canonical issues, PRs and Project coordination record.
Chat LLM: Re-read the current GitHub baseline and the Projects coordination record before making new assumptions.
Human or Chat LLM: Route the request by its actual goal; all starts go through Projects coordination; do not force major planning for routine tasks.
Chat LLM: When given a conversation URL, add or update a lightweight Projects coordination pointer in the owning repo/project file; do not mirror issue details.

Chat LLM: Before a pause, record only the source PR/issue links, current blocker, resume condition and conversation URL in Projects; routine low-risk Projects changes may be autonomously merged under its own policy.
Chat LLM: On human-authorised abandonment, record why the work stopped and update or remove stale Projects handoff links, preserving canonical issues/PR history.
Human or Chat LLM: Capture reproduction, observed-versus-expected behaviour, logs, versions, screenshots and context.
Human or Chat LLM: Select human interactive, Chat LLM research or Coding LLM investigation
Human: Execute local UI or debugger steps from the Chat LLM request and return reproducible evidence.
Chat LLM: Investigate directly where tools allow; a verified fix proceeds through issue and PR workflow, otherwise escalate with focused evidence.
Human or Chat LLM: Evaluate whether logs, reproduction, tests and human feedback support the root cause; loop or reframe if they do not.
Chat LLM: Supply the coding-agent investigation prompt to the human with reproduction, hypotheses, testing expectations and exact PR/issue context.
Human or Chat LLM: Specify the test to add or update, with unit, txtar, integration or scenario proof that would demonstrate the bug and prevent a recurrence; implement it with the fix later.
Chat LLM: Explain why a manual device/UI debugger run is needed, give steps, flowchart or rationale, and ask the human for exact observations and output.
Coding LLM: Investigate the prepared prompt in a repository/worktree, run experiments and tests, and send findings back to Chat LLM for verification; do not self-approve the diagnosis.
Human: Describe what, why, constraints, examples and desired approach; answer and ask questions
Chat LLM: Ask targeted questions; revise scope after every material change
Chat LLM: Search for conflicts in requirements, design, scope, tests and assumptions; route yes to resolution and no to sufficiency check.
Human: Decide between conflicting requirements, ask follow-up questions, then recheck the revised specification.
Human or Chat LLM: Advance when sufficient, not necessarily complete; otherwise loop or park
Chat LLM: Search existing issues and PRs; align expected outcomes and acceptance cases
Human or Chat LLM: Check missing tests, issue ownership, resolving scope and change implications
Human: Decide whether an issue should be created or materially rewritten; routine authorised updates to existing issues need no fresh approval.
Chat LLM: Record canonical requirements and acceptance checks in issues and PR descriptions, not duplicated into Projects.
Human or Chat LLM: After recording canonical issue/spec requirements, decide if a new repository needs bootstrapping or an existing repository can proceed.
Human or Chat LLM: Choose scope from dependencies and likely conflicts, not arbitrary linear stacking
Chat LLM: Map sibling PRs that can merge independently and dependent children that must wait
Human or Chat LLM: Choose an independently runnable leaf; if none is available record why work is blocked; cancel only with human agreement.
Chat LLM: After human scope approval, initialise the repository, essential CI, documentation and licence, delegating source setup to the coding model as needed
Human or Chat LLM: This reachable gate follows publication of each PR; decide whether to prepare an explicit dogfood/UI test before review.
Chat LLM: Select practical UI/dogfood steps, Playwright, screenshot, prototype, txtar or scenario evidence for the current PR milestone, and attach or request evidence for review.
Human or Chat LLM: Chat should fix small scoped changes itself when it has adequate access and verification; otherwise delegate with a prompt.
Chat LLM: Include branch, canonical issue acceptance criteria, PR dependencies, regression tests and txtar/scenario/integration tests where helpful.
Coding LLM: Write or update unit and larger end-to-end, txtar, integration or scenario proof, then run tests and inspect output.
Coding LLM (Codex/Agy): Push real commits and create the promised PRs, with explicit dependent bases and linked issues
Chat LLM: Directly implement when capable, add focused regression and scenario proof, publish to PR, otherwise delegate to EX02.
Chat LLM: Verify published commits, comments, PR metadata, dependencies and fresh tests
Chat LLM: Check current head and mandatory CI evidence, distinguish missing quota from actual success; route required blocked checks to coordination hold.
Human or Chat LLM: Review correctness, test quality, realistic high-level txtar/scenario coverage, issue/PR traceability and code-level tests.
Human or Chat LLM: Route repair to smallest appropriate stage, including back to Q&A and issue specifications
Human: Resolve trivial conflict or tiny fix; Chat may patch when authorised, then republish and review
Chat LLM: Produce targeted prompt for Codex/Agy; repair existing branch/PR when safe
Human: Review the PR and test meaningful UI or bug behaviour; delegate screenshots, Playwright or prototypes when they can provide reliable evidence.
Human: Explicit approval; passing CI or model readiness is not merge authority
GitHub / CI: Merge only valid, approved PR with required checks and dependency prerequisites satisfied
Human or Chat LLM: Update bases and conflicts; choose another ready sibling or pause dependent branch
Human or Chat LLM: After reviewing the PR, decide whether interactive UI/bug proof or automated Playwright/scenario evidence is needed; do not assume an earlier bug hypothesis was correct.
Human: Run a local or installed build, reproduce the original bug, test changed UI and report whether the analysis/PR actually solved it; return discrepancies for revision.
Chat LLM: Provide or delegate trusted UI automation, Playwright, screenshots, previews, integration tests or txtar/scenario evidence, attached to PR or shared for human assessment.
Human or Chat LLM: Compare manual and automated results against issue requirements and original bug hypothesis; route incorrect analysis back to diagnosis or issue correction.
Chat LLM: Verify canonical issues, resolving keywords, regression and scenario proof, remaining blockers and correct PR merge state.
Chat LLM: Check version constraints, dependent PRs, projects and actionable update notices
Chat LLM: Keep the arran4/projects handoff index current at milestone closeout; issues/PRs carry implementation detail, Projects links conversation, status, blockers and next action.
Chat LLM: Update arran4/public-relations with accurate materials or future campaign tasks
Human or Chat LLM: Use accepted scope, roadmap, merged changes and release guidance; patch may be routine if authorised
Human: May choose no release, normal versioned release, or delayed/public opening
Human: If private-to-public, require broader quality, provenance, licence, copyright and link checks
Chat LLM: Inspect repository history, links, copyright, documentation, quality and release assets
Human: Force-push or rewrite only on explicit informed approval; consider collaborators and tags
Human: Make public only after verified audit and approval
GitHub / CI: Use documented release-safe action to tag and publish; no duplicate release publisher
Human or Chat LLM: Decide whether published assets, tag, package, repository visibility and downstream checks really succeeded; otherwise record failed release.
Human or Chat LLM: Determine whether secret, history, licence, link and quality checks are adequate; unresolved fundamental issues return to design, while blocking items pause release.
Chat LLM: Inspect actual GitHub tag, release, uploaded artifacts, package/overlay and visibility after the release workflow, then hand off the outcome for confirmation.
GitHub / CI: Work and any authorised release completed; issue and tracker state reconciled
Chat LLM: Record a concrete resumption trigger, owner, conversation URL and authoritative issue/PR links in Projects when applicable.
Human: Explicitly abandon the work and reconcile obsolete issues/PRs, with a concise Projects coordination update.
Human: A new project or first public version
Human: A feature or change of any size; classify scope later
Human: An observed failure, including interactive Flutter problems
Human: Manual or automated upkeep; also may be folded into another workstream
Human: Resume an existing issue, PR tree or review checkpoint
Human: Release-only entry that does not require new code
